fields.label: Images
fields.description: Number of image rows; recomputed on every save.

fields.label: Total Size (bytes)
fields.description: Sum of the image file sizes; recomputed on every save.

fields.label: Created By
fields.description: The user who uploaded the images. Set at insert; a migrated dataset records the owner of the task it was split out of.

fields.label: Images
fields.description: Fixed once the dataset exists: rows cannot be added or removed. Create a new dataset to change the inputs.

fields.label: Ground Control
fields.description: Optional ground control point file (ODM format) that travels with the images: it is sent to the processing node as gcp_list.txt for every task over this dataset. Unlike the images it may be attached, replaced or removed later; tasks dispatched afterwards use the new file.

fields.label: GCP File
fields.description: /private/files/... URL of the ground control file (ODM gcp_list format).

fields.label: GCP Filename
fields.description: Name the file was uploaded with (the node always receives it as gcp_list.txt).

fields.label: GCP Summary
fields.description: Parsed at upload: coordinate system, point count, image names referenced and which of them are not in this dataset.

fields.label: GCP Object Storage Key
fields.description: Canonical object key of the GCP file in the configured bucket; empty until synced.
